title: opilia acuminata
intro: Opilia acuminata, commonly known as Kavala or Kavalam, is a shrub-like plant belonging to the family Opiliaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including its use in treating fever, rheumatism, and skin disorders. The therapeutic actions of Opilia acuminata are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help in reducing pain and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
